cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# Layer board/secret overrides (sdkconfig.defaults.local) on top of the
# committed defaults. The .local file is generated by scripts/flash_firmware.sh
# from env vars and should not be committed (contains Wi-Fi credentials).
set(SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS "sdkconfig.defaults;sdkconfig.defaults.local")

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(voice_robot_m0)
